snippet.title: WISE GUYS Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
WISE GUYS NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725630/WISE_GUYS 

Wise Guys is a ruthless, high-stakes social deduction game where trust is a weapon and betrayal is just survival. Up to 8 players race against time to clean up their criminal operation and get out before the raid hits. Meanwhile, a Rat is quietly sabotaging the crew at every turn.

Expose the Rat and The Boss MIGHT spare your life. BUT... choose the wrong guy, trust the wrong voice, OR believe the wrong story and the Rat walks free... while you're left holding the body bags.
